our-story.title: Our Story
our-story.part-1: Hoopla was born from a simple idea: to make great coffee more accessible. We partner with the best local coffee shops to make your days more flavorful and enjoyable, and to make enjoying coffee even more convenient and easy. No matter your tastes, our carefully curated subscription ensures that you will always discover something new and delicious.
our-story.part-2: We’re here to support local businesses while giving coffee lovers an effortless way to enjoy their favorite blends. Hoopla is your connection to a world of premium coffee experiences, all in one subscription.
our-story.part-3: At Hoopla, coffee is more than a drink—it's a bridge that connects people, stories, and cultures. With every sip, you’re not just enjoying a brew; you’re becoming part of a vibrant community that values quality, authenticity, and connection. Let’s redefine your coffee experience, one cup at a time.

terms.title: PUBLIC OFFER
terms.content:
Provision of services for subscription access

Limited Liability Company "ALPHAZET TECHNOLOGIES", hereinafter referred to as the "Company," represented by its director acting under the Charter, offers to enter into a Public Offer Agreement for the provision of services for subscription access (hereinafter – the Offer, also referred to as the Agreement or Contract) under the following terms:


TERMS AND DEFINITIONS

“Subscription” – the User's right to receive a certain number of cups of coffee at the Company's partner establishments within the billing period, issued through the mobile application "HOOPLA".

“Subscription Activation” – an action by the User aimed at gaining actual access to the subscription after its purchase.

“Subscription Cancellation” – termination of the subscription due to the User’s violation of the Offer’s terms.

“Partner” – an individual entrepreneur or legal entity registered in the Republic of Uzbekistan, providing coffee services in partner coffee shops participating in the "HOOPLA" program.

“User” – an individual of legal age who has subscribed through the "HOOPLA" application to receive coffee at Partner establishments.

“Mobile Application” – the digital platform "HOOPLA", available on iOS and Android, which enables subscription management.

GENERAL PROVISIONS

1.1. The text of this document is a public offer. In accordance with Article 367 of the Civil Code of the Republic of Uzbekistan, a public offer is an invitation to enter into a contract under the specified conditions with any person who agrees to them.

1.2. Actions indicating acceptance of the Offer (subscription purchase, use of the "HOOPLA" application) constitute acceptance of the Offer.

1.3. The Company reserves the right to make changes to this Offer without prior notice to Users. The updated version comes into effect from the moment it is published in the "HOOPLA" mobile application.

RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS OF THE PARTIES

2.1. The Company undertakes to:

  • Provide Users with access to subscriptions through the "HOOPLA" application;
  • Publish up-to-date information about Partners, their service conditions, and operating hours;
  • Ensure technical support for the application.

2.2. The User undertakes to:

  • Use the subscription within the specified limit (1 cup of coffee per day);
  • Not transfer the subscription to third parties;
  • Follow the service rules at Partner coffee shops.

SUBSCRIPTION PURCHASE AND USAGE TERMS

3.1. The subscription is issued through the "HOOPLA" application and is personal.

3.2. The subscription price is set by the Company and specified in the application.

3.3. The subscription is valid for 30 calendar days from the moment of activation.

3.4. If the User violates the terms of use, the Company has the right to cancel the subscription without a refund.

LIABILITY OF THE PARTIES

4.1. The Company is not responsible for the quality of services provided by Partners.

4.2. In the event of technical failures or temporary service unavailability, the Company undertakes to resolve the issue within a reasonable timeframe.

DISPUTE RESOLUTION

5.1. Disputes arising from this Offer shall be resolved through negotiations. If an agreement cannot be reached, the parties have the right to take legal action in the jurisdiction where the Company is located.

CONFIDENTIALITY

6.1. The Company undertakes not to disclose Users' personal data to third parties without their consent, except in cases provided by the legislation of the Republic of Uzbekistan.

FINAL PROVISIONS

7.1. This Offer is valid indefinitely.

7.2. The full text of the Offer is available in the "HOOPLA" application and on the Company's official website.
